description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Look' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Look - the look of the app's interface laid over the project's src/ui.config.ts at start, no rebuild: Theme (UI kit colour tokens -> #rrggbb: bgTop, bgBottom, panel, panelDeep, panelEdge, ink, nav, text, textDim, gold, goldDeep, green, greenDeep, blue, blueDeep, red, redDeep, purple, purpleDeep, orange, orangeDeep, teal, tealDeep; derived tones are computed), Radius and ButtonRadius (px 0..64), Outline (px 0..8), Background (a screen pattern id: gear (the default game-gear pattern), plain, dots, stripes, grid, hex, stars, waves, checker, confetti, bubbles, zigzag, diamonds, clouds, leaves, circuit, sparkles, rays, bricks, paws, snow), MotionSpeed (0.1..5, 1 default), MotionIntensity (0..3, 1 default), Particles, SoundSet (classic, soft, retro, magic, sci-fi, wood). Every field optional; unset keeps the project's own value.

value.description: The look of the app's interface over the project's src/ui.config.ts, without a rebuild: colours, corners, outline, a screen pattern, animations and interface sounds. Every field is optional; what is not set keeps the project's own value.

Background.description: A pattern over the screens' gradient: plain, dots, stripes, grid, hex, stars, waves, checker, confetti, bubbles, zigzag, diamonds, clouds, leaves, circuit, sparkles, rays, bricks, paws, snow.

MotionIntensity.description: Strength of bounces and overshoots: 0 none, 1 default, 2 cartoonish (0..3).

MotionSpeed.description: Speed of the interface animations: 1 default, 2 twice as fast, 0.5 twice as slow (0.1..5).

Outline.description: Thickness of the ink outline around buttons and panels, px (0..8).

Particles.description: Particle bursts on claims and purchases.

Radius.description: Corner radius of panels and cards, px (0..64).

SoundSet.description: Interface sound style, synthesized (no files): classic, soft, retro, magic, sci-fi, wood.

Theme.description: Main colour tokens of the UI kit theme, token -> #rrggbb: bgTop, bgBottom (the screens' gradient), panel, panelDeep, panelEdge, ink (the outline of everything), nav (the bottom bar), text, textDim, gold, goldDeep, green, greenDeep, blue, blueDeep, red, redDeep, purple, purpleDeep, orange, orangeDeep, teal, tealDeep. Derived tones (text on buttons, lines, wells) are computed from these.
